description: The file defines the SiloRoleBasedPlacement class, which is a placement strategy for assigning grains to silos based on roles in the Orleans distributed framework. It includes a singleton instance and some metadata attributes.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacement
classes.description: A placement strategy specifying that a grain should be placed on a silo with a specific role as indicated by the placement attribute in Orleans.

methods.name: Singleton
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of the SiloRoleBasedPlacement class.
